name: synctaller
description: Orquestación del monorepo: backend/ (Laravel) y frontend/ (React). No es un workspace de npm.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && composer install && php -r "file_exists('.env') || copy('.env.example', '.env');" && php artisan key:generate
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
